text:
sophia: Quick flag 1: sample-app sampler mode returned `[candidate]` for n=1 in hosted API; TS SDK validator failed on `.isObject` check. Python didn't complain.
liam: Hmm, is that the new sampler rollout? We expected scalar for n=1. Any logs?
sophia: Repro steps in samplekit: set `sampler: {n_candidates:1}`, trigger tool via `function_call=auto`. Response payload:```json
{"tool_outputs": [{"name":"parse_address","args":{"street":"42 Pine"}}]}
```
dina: Saw similar in local stub earlier. The runtime collectCandidates() is normalizing to array always. Looks intentional from an earlier refactor.
omear: That explains parity break. TS helper code does `if (!isObject(result)) throw` and chokes on `[{...}]`. We should avoid silent coercion in SDK by default.
sophia: Agree. For DX we need a two-pronged approach: 1) decide server contract (always-array vs unwrap-for-single); 2) make SDKs explicit opt-in for unwrap behavior with a clear name and docs.
liam: Suggestion: ship server-side change to follow contract 'always-array' (simpler), then SDKs add `unwrapSingleCandidate: boolean` option default false. Docs updated to show how to enable.
dina: If server stays adaptive, SDK option should be opt-in and documented. Also add a strict validator mode in TS to help onboarding.
omear: Also spotted an auth refresh bug where middleware stringified `args` after retry, turning `args` into a string. That caused schema validators to fail downstream. Example from logs: "args":"{\"street\":\"42 Pine\"}".
sophia: That's RT-2050 auth-retry-arg-encoding? We should file a ticket and add a unit test that simulates token expiry and ensures objects remain objects after retry.
ci-bot: CI: samplekit-e2e #211 failed on linux - see https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/211 for logs :warning:
liam: The failing e2e was the TS validator throw. I can prep a test matrix that runs python+ts against the hosted endpoint and asserts shape parity.
dina: For short-term unblock, I'll add a `sdkHelpers.unwrapSingleCandidate` opt-in in the TS SDK with clear deprecation plan if server changes. It will be behind an explicit config flag.
omear: Make sure we also handle nullable fields: when candidate is `[null]` the helper should respect schema nullable semantics; i.e., treat `[null]` as valid array of nulls vs unwrap to null. Edgecases need tests.
sophia: Ops: I'll open two tickets: RT-2060 'sampler output parity decision' and RT-2061 'auth-retry double-encode'. Also adding samplekit e2e case to block on.
ci-bot: Issue RT-2060 created by sophia: https://tickets.internal/RT-2060
ci-bot: Issue RT-2061 created by sophia: https://tickets.internal/RT-2061
liam: I'll draft the docs patch showing both behaviors and how to opt-in for unwrap in SDKs. Keep examples in both JS and Py.
dina: One more note: quickstart tutorial currently shows `tool_result` as an object. Docs will confuse users if server returns array. Good catch.
omear: For tests: add e2e that posts a prompt, checks `tool_outputs` type, runs with n=1 and n=3, and runs auth-refresh path. I can add that to samplekit CI.
sophia: Thanks. Let's avoid auto-coercion in helpers unless opt-in. Also call out the change in the migration guide.
liam: I'll assign docs PR to myself and link RT issues.
dina: I'll land the SDK opt-in with tests.
sophia: Great. Tagging this thread on the devex board and the samplekit sprint. :rocket:
